seesai.note: Three historical UKRI beneficiary offers verified. Phase 3 is matched to AABS and is not a separate grant. Other dated financing remains partial.

sensefly-ageagle-aerial-systems.note: Two distinct Parrot transactions verified. 2012 sources conflict on original currency and 2016 original CHF payment is not established. A separately sourced final CHF100,000 Venture Kick grant is prepared for the next manifest.

sensofusion.note: Updated IPO gross primary proceeds. Separate Series B exact subscription proceeds and 2024/2026 share issues require reconciliation with existing records and original prospectus before importing.

sensrad.note: Verified SEK1 upfront secondary transfer. Shareholder loan flows and noncash conversions are not yet reconciled at facility level.

sensusq.note: Two earlier financing events verified. Do not infer seed roles from portfolio relationship.

septentrio.note: Four beneficiary grants verified. Four additional FP7 allocations are prepared for a subsequent review. Founder described cumulative earlier rounds and a 2002 raise without event amounts.

shotling.note: October 2025 USD325k entry conflicts with cited round reporting and lacks primary event-level confirmation. Existing 2026 mixed round retained.

silixcon.note: Smart BMS award verified. Existing rounded grants have original signed contract evidence queued for guarded amount, qualifier and date reconciliation.

siralab-robotics.note: ODESSA award verified. D4BRIGHT approved research procurement is not financing. SMiP amount remains unverified at original-source level.

sistemi-dinamici-leonardo.note: EUR9m shareholder refinancing verified. IDS historic loan balance and interdivisional balances do not establish original facilities. Intragroup merger excluded.

six-robotics.note: 2024 grant offer verified. Cumulative external equity has no dated discrete breakdown. Offer acceptance unknown.

sky-drones.note: Exact UKRI workbook participant offers improve three existing awards. Spend and consortium budgets are separately scoped.

sky-fortress.note: Original military reporting distinguishes Sky Fortress and Zvook. Zvook’s venture financing cannot be transferred across identities. No attributable closed event found in this check.

sky-watch.note: Four EU grants and separate credit facility verified. The AIRO acquisition, accounting valuation and shareholder debt waiver need further structured treatment review before import.

safran.note: 2014 bond, 2020 May OCEANE issuance and October tap verified. Other US private placements and earlier OCEANEs remain partial.

rift.note: Both publications substantiate public support but the instrument and executed recipient allocation terms remain unresolved.

quantum-systems.note: Republished issuer confirmation and contemporaneous independent issuer quotation substantiate 2021 closed growth financing. Legal vehicle and round lead for the second participant were not inferred.

skyassist.note: Industry financing summaries and general Brave1 grant programmes did not identify an attributable dated award. Earlier founder and friends funding remains unallocated.

skybound.note: Beauhurst reports four rounds totalling GBP7.68m and a GBP52.5k grant. Original transaction parties and dates remain unresolved.

skycorp-technologies.note: Existing 2023 pre-seed confirmed. The ESA profile is for Skycorp OÜ and does not establish an executed allocation to the catalogue issuer.

skycutter.note: Search results describe procurement and soliciting funding without attributable closed financing. Contract ceilings are excluded.

skyports.note: January 2018 seed with Levitate confirmed from issuer. Hold exact amount and any distinct Series B later closing for original disclosure.
